short: Spectrum WellCare provides individualized acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine in MetroWest Orlando. Ajay Purohit is a Florida-licensed Acupuncture Physician who offers acupuncture, personalized Chinese herbal medicine, and related integrative services.
training: Doctorate in Traditional Chinese Medicine, Five Branches University; Master of Public Health in Health Systems Management and BS in Psychology, Tulane University; acupuncture and Chinese medicine training, Florida College of Integrative Medicine.
pricing: Initial and follow-up visit rates vary. Call 407-347-5038 for current self-pay pricing. Insurance coverage and out-of-pocket costs depend on your plan.
long: Spectrum WellCare provides personalized acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine in MetroWest Orlando. Florida-licensed Acupuncture Physician Ajay Purohit offers acupuncture, individualized Chinese herbal medicine, and MPS microcurrent therapy. The clinic serves Orlando and nearby Central Florida communities and has provided care since 2012. Insurance and VA Community Care benefits may be available with verification and required authorization. Call 407-347-5038 to ask about services, coverage, and current self-pay rates.
size: Continue serving patients in MetroWest Orlando and Central Florida while maintaining a manageable patient schedule
address: 2295 S Hiawassee Rd Ste 207,, Orlando, FL 32835
